question: Quality Acceptance Threshold for Quantization: W4A16 (4-bit weights, 16-bit activations) typically results in < 1% accuracy drop on standard benchmarks for 7B+ models if calibrated properly. FP8 (E4M3/E5M2) shows negligible loss (< 0.5%). BF16 is baseline. The 'acceptable' loss depends on application: Code generation is more sensitive to quantization artifacts than general chat. [待核验 specific Qwen3-27B quantization reports] alternative
